name: roadmap
description: A live pane that draws the project's ROADMAP.md as a timeline: overall progress, one row per phase, and tasks you can tick off. It opens by itself when the project has a ROADMAP.md, checks for it every 1.5 seconds to pick up changes, and edits it only when you tick or untick a task in the pane (or press Create roadmap). No network access.
